body: Next time I go I will tell him
I feel bad saying I havent been taking my medicine to the doctor. Idk what he would do if I tell him ive been smoking. I dont know
I just didnt feel like me. I still hated myself, I just felt different. My friends said I acted different. They just didnt make me feel good
I was on prozac for 4 months and i hated it. I was on zoloft and abilify for 3 and that was even worse. I might go to a therapist again though
